Residue: Beads: 2721D has 1sm. shell elliptical bead; 2721-F has a convexo-cylindrical long bead (.35 long), 2721-I has short convexo-cylindrical or really cylindrical bead 1.2cm long. 1 cm dia.; 2721-J has vxocyl bd same sz as 2721-I; 2721-k has a phalanges stuck to it; 2721-N has a ~6 cm convex-cylindrical or long elongate bead stuck to it. 2721-M is the largest pc and has 4 sm convexo-cylindrical beads stuck to it. Some appear to be twined tapestry skeletal wefts in light brown or brown. 2721-I has both black and red yarns stuck to it. Largest frag is the one w/ 4 little convexo-cylindrical beads.
